title: The Daily Grind – White Chocolate Peppermint Latte 100ML
description:
The Daily Grind – White Chocolate Peppermint Latte 100ML
Get ahead of the daily grind with an invigorating selection of coffee house vape juice. Every bit as creamy and delicious as the real thing, these fresh cafe-style flavours are developed in the UK, produced in Australia.
A fresh, peppermint latte with creamy milk and white chocolate sauce.
Primary Flavours
: White Chocolate, Peppermint, Coffee, Milk
PG/VG Ratio:
70 VG / 30 PG
Bottle Sizes:
100ml
Nicotine:
0 MG
